messages:
Maya: Heads up — opened an RFC + PR to standardize log <-> trace correlation across services. PR: https://git.redwood/inference/platform/PR-421. TL;DR: add trace identifiers to all structured logs (trace_id, span_id), and make sure our OTLP/Fluentd pipeline preserves those fields so dashboards can link logs <-> spans. Looking for quick feedback before we start changing logging libs.

Priya: link to the RFC? curious about cost/retention implications.

Maya: https://docs.redwood/inference/rfc/log-trace-correlation.md (short read). Key constraints: 1) do NOT attach span payloads to every log, only ids; 2) keep field names stable across languages; 3) exporter should not drop the fields when converting to OTLP/JSON.

Jared: minor thing — are we standardizing on "trace_id" vs "trace.id" vs "otel.trace_id"? different backends like Splunk/Loki/Datadog have their own field name habits.

Ethan: From OTEL side, trace_id is the hex string returned by span.context().trace_id. I vote for trace_id (snake_case) because it maps nicely to existing Fluentd field names and is easy to query in Loki.

Priya: cost question: if logs include ids, do we now need to keep traces longer? joining old logs to expired traces will be harder.

Maya: good point. Proposal in RFC: logs keep ids always; traces continue to follow current retention (7d). Dashboards that need deep trace + log correlation should be built to fall back gracefully when traces are gone (show logs with trace_id and say "trace expired"). We should also offer an optional policy to retain sampled traces for 30d for high-value customers.

Luis: alternative: keep a small lookup store (trace_id -> root_span_meta) for 30d so we can at least show minimal trace metadata even if spans were GC'd. That store could be cheap (only root id, service, start_ts, sampled flag).

Jared: implementation questions for ingestion: Fluentd currently flattens JSON and sometimes renames fields. We must update the fluentd filter to not rename trace_id -> traceId or drop it. Also need a migration to backfill old logs with request_id -> trace_id when available.

Ethan: suggested logging pattern for app libs (example):

```json
{"ts":"2026-03-18T15:12:01Z","level":"info","service":"api","msg":"request finished","trace_id":"4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736","span_id":"00f067aa0ba902b7","request_id":"req_123"}
```

And in OTEL instrumentation we set: `log_record.attributes['trace_id'] = trace.get_span(context).get_span_context().trace_id` (pseudo).

Priya: languages — do we need separate libs for go/node/python?

Ethan: short answer yes. We'll add small middleware wrappers in each infra repo. For node: tiny bunyan/ pino serializer. For go: zap wrapper. For python: structlog wrapper. Keep them backward compatible (config flag enable_trace_fields).

Maya: migration plan (from RFC):
1) Week 1: Add opt-in flag to logging libs and update 5 services in staging.
2) Week 2: Update Fluentd/OTLP pipeline to preserve trace fields and start tagging in staging index.
3) Week 3: Flip on for all backend request logs (not worker/cron) behind a feature flag.
4) Week 4–6: Update dashboards and create a "logs -> trace" quicklink in Console that uses trace_id.
5) Post-migration: consider small lookup store if we want 30d minimal trace metadata.

Jared: I'll own the Fluentd change and a migration script for old logs (search for request_id -> join where we have instrumented request_id). Will open PR for filters.

Luis: I'll prototype the lookup store with 3 fields and rough cost estimate.

Priya: sounds reasonable — can we add a guardrail so un-sampled traces don't cause a ton of OTLP export traffic?

Maya: definitely — we only export full spans for sampled traces. Trace ids are just identifiers in logs, they don't trigger export. We'll document that clearly in the RFC.

ops-bot: deploy: logging-lib v2.3 -> staging succeeded (build 2379).

Ethan: small nit — will we also map the W3C traceparent header in our API gateway to trace_id automatically? otherwise downstream services won't have the id.

Maya: yes — API gateway will extract traceparent and set trace_id in the request context. We'll add that to the gateway PR.

Priya: ok i'm +1 on phased rollout. please add a short checklist in the PR so oncall can triage any dashboard fallout.

Maya: will do. thanks everyone, will update RFC with action items and dates. :thumbsup:
